subject: Final approval committee and signing guardrails — scheduling signatures and start date
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@aperture.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + evaluation plan attached — proposed sign-off cadence

Elena — attaching the updated mutual action plan and the condensed evaluation plan you requested. Key asks in this note:

- Please confirm the executive approver (name & availability) for signature.
- Confirm if legal needs a revised clause for data residency — we can provide an addendum.
- Proposed final signature window: Tue Nov 9 — Thu Nov 11 (we'll send DocuSign).
- Target start of onboarding: Tue Nov 16 (one week after signatures).

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf (MAP with milestone owners), EvaluationPlan_Q4.xlsx (30/60/90 eval checkpoints).

If you prefer a shorter approval window, tell me your latest acceptable start date and we’ll compress the milestones. I’ll coordinate internal approvers once you confirm the exec signer.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: Elena Novak <elena@aperture.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aperture Legal <legal@aperture.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan attached — proposed sign-off cadence

Karthik — thanks for the docs. Quick answers:

- Executive approver will be Alison Grant (CPO). She is available Mon Nov 8 afternoon or Tue Nov 9 morning.
- Legal: they want one change to the audit log retention language; legal@aperture.ai will list the redline by EOD Monday.
- We can do the shorter window — prefer signatures by Tue Nov 9 so we can start onboarding on Mon Nov 15.

I’ll route the MAP to Alison this afternoon. Please make sure the DocuSign flow supports two signers (Alison + Aperture ops lead).

Best,
Elena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: final sign-off plan for Aperture (RDW-4521)

Marissa / Lauren — client is tightening the window and wants signatures by Tue Nov 9 so onboarding can start Mon Nov 15. Quick coordination notes:

- Marissa: can you confirm exec approval for a Tue Nov 9 signature (who in our org will countersign)? Ideally our Exec Sponsor (VP Product) signs on Wed Nov 10 but client needs our countersign on Nov 9 — we can accept sequential signing if we pre-authorize an operational placeholder. Is that feasible?
- Lauren: legal expects an audit log retention redline from the customer. If Aperture sends the redline, can you triage and either accept or propose a minimal addendum within 24 hours? We need quick turn.

Proposed technical approach: send DocuSign envelope Mon Nov 8 afternoon with signing order — Alison first, Aperture ops lead second, then Redwood's operational counter-sign on receipt. If legal redlines arrive, we optionally attach the addendum into the envelope prior to countersign.

I’ll draft the envelope with conditional fields and link to the MAP folder.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@aperture.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan attached — proposed sign-off cadence

Elena — confirmed on our side:

- We’ll send the DocuSign envelope on Mon Nov 8 at 3:00 PM PT with signing order: Alison (Aperture exec) -> Aperture ops lead -> Redwood operational sign-off (placeholder).
- Marissa verified exec sponsor availability for Mon/Tue and will be on standby for countersign.
- Lauren will review any legal redlines within 24 hours of receipt and escalate only if changes impact data handling.

DocuSign link (will be active Mon): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/1234567890
Drive folder (MAP + eval plan): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedMap

Action items for Aperture: please confirm Alison’s final availability (Mon Nov 8 afternoon or Tue Nov 9 morning) and route legal redlines by EOD Mon Nov 1. If Alison signs Tue morning, we’ll still aim for onboarding Mon Nov 15 but may need to shift a day if countersign lags.

Thanks — looking forward to the greenlight.
Karthik

From: Elena Novak <elena@aperture.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aperture Legal <legal@aperture.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan attached — proposed sign-off cadence

Karthik — quick update: Alison signed via DocuSign at 16:10 PT. Legal has a single-line redline which we attached into the envelope and Alison approved the addendum. Aperture ops lead signs tomorrow morning 11/03 at 9:00 PT and you should receive the final countersign then.

We’ll push to keep Nov 15 as the start date but will confirm after the final countersign. Thanks for making the signing flow simple.

Best,
Elena
Aperture Analytics
notes: Thread contains the finalized MAP, a condensed evaluation plan, DocuSign envelope flow, and a time-sensitive signing window. Internal coordination focused on legal triage and an operational placeholder for countersign to meet the customer’s preferred start date.
